messages:
acme_billing: Hey team — invoice INV-2026-0042 (issued 2026-03-02) has NJ sales tax (6.625%) applied but our bill-to entity is in PA and we already uploaded a PA exemption (ST-4). Need reversal + corrected invoice today please.
zoe_support: Sorry about that — can you paste the invoice and bill-to address so we can triage fast? :thinking_face: 
acme_billing: Invoice INV-2026-0042; Bill-to: Acme Corp — 123 Market St, Philadelphia, PA 19103. Subtotal $12,000, tax $796.50. Certificate uploaded as PA_ST4.pdf on 2026-03-01 under account files.
raj_billing: assigning this. billing-bot: Received request for INV-2026-0042; status: triage.
raj_billing: Quick check in billing UI — account has a legacy primary address in NJ + a distinct bill-to entity set to PA. The tax engine returned NJ. I'm escalating to eng to confirm if tax lookup used the wrong address.
emily_engineering: I reproduced. Tax calculation service is resolving jurisdiction from account.primary_address_id. For accounts with separate bill-to entities we should prefer invoice.bill_to_entity.address_id. Repro steps: 1) create account with primary_address (NJ) + bill_to_entity (PA) 2) create invoice -> tax-service resolves primary -> NJ applied. Minimal repro code: ```js
// wrong lookup
const state = account.primary_address.state
// should use invoice.bill_to_entity.address.state
```  Looks like a fallback path in services/tax/src/resolveJurisdiction.ts line ~84.
zoe_support: Ugh. Customer needs a credit + corrected invoice today. What's the mitigation?
emily_engineering: Short-term: manual credit + reissue (billing can do). Medium-term: I can push a hotfix to prefer invoice.bill_to_entity when present and add unit tests. I'll prepare a rollback-safe patch and aim to deploy in ~2 hours after quick canary. Also will run a one-off audit job for recent invoices.
raj_billing: On manual steps I'll: 1) create credit note CN-2026-0042 for $796.50, 2) reissue corrected invoice INV-2026-0042-R with 0% tax, 3) attach PA_ST4.pdf to the invoice record. Also will flag finance to check remittance if tax was already submitted.
acme_billing: Thanks — please confirm when credit issued, and that the fix will prevent other legacy accounts from getting NJ tax. We have ~12 similar entities.
emily_engineering: Will do. I'll also run a scan for invoices in the last 90 days where tax_jurisdiction_state != bill_to_entity.state and open tickets (ETA 24h). Patch PR: github.com/redwood-inference/services/tax/pull/182. Canary and metrics dashboards will monitor tax rate by state.
zoe_support: Filed internal ticket BW-3321 to track customer communication + billing actions. CC billing & eng.
billing-bot: Note: ticket BW-3321 created; assignees raj_billing, emily_engineering.
raj_billing: Credit CN-2026-0042 created, reissued INV-2026-0042-R with 0% tax and attached PA_ST4.pdf. Sent invoice and credit copies to customer's billing contact.
emily_engineering: Deployed hotfix to prod canary (service tax v1.4.3-canary). Fix confirmed in canary logs for the repro case. Rolling full deploy in 15m. Will follow up with a brief postmortem once scan completes.
acme_billing: Received credit + corrected invoice, thanks both. Appreciate the quick turnaround.
zoe_support: Closing loop for now — will keep open until audit job completes. :white_check_mark:
